labeledFrom: Enumerated web/app/**/page.tsx, confirmed api/ is FastAPI (Python).
shape: Monorepo: Next.js App Router frontend under web/, FastAPI backend under api/ (Python), Supabase migrations under supabase/.
whyThisRepo: A different failure from Skribbl's. Its exports were already detected correctly (99 -> 103 barely moves); what was missing was the App Router directory convention, so all 14 pages were invisible. It is also the honest-coverage case: the entire backend is Python and cannot be parsed at all.

uiRoutes.note: Every page.tsx under web/app. layout.tsx files are deliberately excluded: a layout wraps a route without being navigable.

declaredPaths.note: Derived from the directory tree — App Router has no config file, so this is the only place the URL exists.

httpRoutes.note: Not a miss. The API is FastAPI in Python (api/routers/*.py) and no parser reads Python. The coverage line must say so rather than implying the repo has no backend.

knownGaps: api/ is Python: ~40 route handlers across api/routers/ are entirely outside the analysis. This is the case that makes the parsed-vs-in-scope distinction load-bearing — reporting 167 files 'analyzed' implied the backend had been read.
